docs-scene3d-ci.description: Docs route under CI software rasterization with lazy WebGL fallback preserved. Carries the CSS-aware alpha-mask pass-routing payload; the latest isolated final built runtime software-browser run measured JS 1307.04KiB (<= 1550), network 1530.28KiB, LCP 1660ms (<= 18000), TBT 1173ms (<= 15000). Only network exceeded the prior 1526KiB cap, so the cap moves to 1531KiB — the next integer KiB above the measured 1530.28KiB payload, since the measurement falls between integer bounds and a same-integer cap would sit below it; the other gates passed. No hardware certification is implied.

water-ci.description: Water route under CI software rasterization. Gates load, the reviewed O-series browser-host and runtime payload, and total blocking time; long-task count is intentionally ungated because continuous software-raster frames straddle the 50ms boundary. Real-GPU cadence is certified separately. The latest remote CI browser run (head cf7db22) measured 1672.68KiB network payload (LCP 684ms, TBT 5160ms, both passing), the only failing gate; the typed alpha-interpolation patch adds 152 raw bytes each to the WebGPU chunk and bootstrap (152/1024 = 0.1484375KiB, ~1672.83KiB projected), so the assertion moves to 1673KiB as the narrow integer-KiB ceiling over the observed remote measurement plus the increment. Fresh remote CI on the patched head is pending; the measurements come from the software browser, not a physical GPU.
